normalization: Unicode NFKC, lowercase, identifier/path tokens, one-to-four word n-grams joined by space, hyphen, or empty string

sensitivity.derivation: Candidate-sensitive digests are the source-path component/token universe minus the closed ISS-001 and platform-publication path vocabulary; explicit arbitrary-text collision sets then remove values present in the complete ISS-001, package, and bundle-input text surfaces before boundary enforcement.

publicationFingerprintCensus.derivation: Canonical rows/chunks, key-independent typed value rows, and flattened typed scalar streams with order-independent subset relationships across bounded arbitrary text; scalar syntax position does not grant exclusion, valid continuations and static template fragments are reconstructed without evaluation, and collision-resistant strings are independently marked.
